meta_description:
elleindia on November 11, 2025: "#ELLECoverStar: When Nidhi Sunil (@nidhisunil) first appeared on the cover of ELLE India back in 2011, she was unsuspecting of where her life’s twists and turns would eventually lead her. Too dark, too short—people were quick to label her in outmoded parrot tones. “But that cover was special. Your team didn’t edit my skin. I looked like my true South Indian self,” she recalls. Sunil is easily one of our finest exports to the west—which Indian model can boast of a L'Oreal Paris contract in her kitty?! Back in 2021, she became the first Indian model to achieve this feat. Over the years, she has fronted numerous international campaigns, enjoyed the world of high-fashion editorials and used her global platform to advocate for diversity and ethical beauty. Head to the 🔗 in bio to read the full conversation with our cover star.
____________________________________
On @nidhisunil: LOVE unlimited bracelets and rings, all by @cartier. Small panel asymmetric dress by @louisvuitton.
____________________________________
Editorial Director: Ainee Nizami Ahmedi (@aineenizamiahmedi)
Photographer: Raajadharshini (@raajadharshini)
Fashion Director: Zoha Castelino (@zohacastelino)
Asst. Art Director: Alekha Chugani (@alekhachuganii)
Makeup: Sandhya Shekhar (@sandhyashekar)
Hair: Umang Thapa (@umang.artist) rep by Anima (@animacreatives) 
Bookings Editor: Rishith Shetty (@rishithvshetty)
Words by: Ipsita Kaul (@ipsitakaul)
Assisted by: Tejashree Raul (@tejashreeraul), Anshu Sheth (@uncultured.by.anshu) (styling), Sharayu Karalkar (@sharayukaralkar) (bookings)
Airline Partner: Emirates (@emirates)
________________________________________
Read the full story in ELLE India’s new issue.
________________________________
#ELLECovers #NidhiSunil #IndianModels".
